subject: Confirming demo time for Kyoto on-site + remote attendees
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Tanaka <kai.tanaka@cloudspark.jp>, Hannah Lee <h.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 01:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kyoto on-site window — proposed hybrid demo slots

Hi Kai / Hannah —

Thanks again for confirming you're on-site in Kyoto next week. To avoid the usual hotel-clock vs calendar confusion, proposing two concrete windows for the hybrid demo we want to run with your team and a small number of remote engineers:

- Option A: Fri Feb 19, 09:30 JST (Fri 00:30 UTC / Thu 16:30 PT) — 45 min run
- Option B: Fri Feb 19, 14:00 JST (Fri 05:00 UTC / Thu 21:00 PT) — 45 min run

Note: some of our internal calendars show the invite in local time (PST) and others in UTC. I want to be explicit: the times above are local to Kyoto (JST). Hotel clocks can be set incorrectly at event venues — please confirm you want the on-site group in room SAKURA at the Kyoto Conference Center at the JST times above.

If both work, we can pick A and I’ll send the calendar invite with the Zoom link and runbook attached. If only one works for on-site folks, call it out and I’ll adjust.

Attachments: proposed-demo-runbook.md (outline of the sequence + fallbacks)

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Developer Relations, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Kai Tanaka <kai.tanaka@cloudspark.jp>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Lee <h.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 17:15:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Kyoto on-site window — proposed hybrid demo slots

Thanks Vivek — we appreciate the explicit JST note. Quick heads-up from our side: the room coordinator at the venue usually posts a physical schedule in the lobby that lists local time but sometimes sets the clocks a few minutes fast; some of our team will also be joining remotely from Europe (CET) and one engineer will be traveling from San Francisco (PST).

Option A (09:30 JST) is tight for the San Francisco engineer (that’s 16:30 PT on Thu) but still doable. Option B (14:00 JST) would be late for our CET remote folks (that’s 05:00 CET).

Can we do a compromise: Fri Feb 19, 10:00 JST (Fri 01:00 UTC / Thu 17:00 PT / Fri 02:00 CET) — this shifts a bit later for on-site but avoids the CET overnight window for most of our EU team. If that works for Redwood, please send an invite anchored to JST and note in the invite text: "All times listed in JST (Asia/Tokyo). On-site room SAKURA; remote via Zoom."

Attachment: kyoto-demo-venue-map.pdf (for room logistics)

—
Kai Tanaka
Senior Solutions Engineer, CloudSpark
kai.tanaka@cloudspark.jp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Kai Tanaka <kai.tanaka@cloudspark.jp>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Lee <h.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 18:03:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Kyoto on-site window — proposed hybrid demo slots

Thanks Kai — 10:00 JST (Fri) sounds reasonable. Two quick operational asks from our side:

1) Vivek, please set the calendar invite timezone explicitly to Asia/Tokyo and put the line: "Times in this invite are JST (Asia/Tokyo) — please double-check your calendar client." That avoids the DST / client display bug we've seen.
2) Karthik, can you confirm we have a fallback recording plan in case the SAKURA room clock is wrong and the on-site group arrives early? We should be ready to start streaming to the Zoom room 10 minutes early and note that on the room door.

Also — Kai / Hannah — any chance your SF engineer (Hiro) can confirm they can do Thu 17:00 PT? If Hiro can't, we'll keep a recording and a short follow-up session for them.

—
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kai Tanaka <kai.tanaka@cloudspark.jp>, Hannah Lee <h.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 00:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kyoto on-site window — proposed hybrid demo slots

Marissa / Vivek —

Got it. I’ll prepare the runbook to start streaming 10 minutes early and we’ll pin a note for the on-site coordinator to check the SAKURA room clock. I’ll also include a short checklist for the AV tech: camera, mic, and a backup laptop with our recorded session queued.

I’m adding the final Zoom link and the calendar invite once Vivek confirms the 10:00 JST anchor.

Best,
Karthik
Platform Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Tanaka <kai.tanaka@cloudspark.jp>, Hannah Lee <h.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 12:20:00 +09:00
Subject: Confirmed: Fri Feb 19, 10:00 JST — Kyoto SAKURA room + Zoom

Confirmed for Fri Feb 19 at 10:00 JST (Asia/Tokyo). Calendar invite sent and pinned to JST timezone. Notes in the invite: 

- On-site: SAKURA room, Kyoto Conference Center (map attached).
- Remote: Zoom (https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=demo) — join 10 minutes early to verify AV.
- Fallback: session will be recorded; we’ll schedule a 30-minute follow-up with Hiro (SF) if needed.

Attachments: kyoto-demo-venue-map.pdf, proposed-demo-runbook.md

See you all there — Vivek will open the runbook at T-5 and Karthik will run the stream.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Developer Relations, Redwood Inference
